sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original raster material artwork for a small Audion-inspired desktop music-player skin, not a screenshot. Keep a broad uninterrupted walnut faceplate occupying most of the image; no decorative music dials. Subtle material detail visible at small UI scale. Use case: original game/ui skin artwork. Create a polished original late-1990s Audion-inspired desktop music-player object, with a TRANSPARENT EXTERIOR, viewed perfectly flat FRONT orthographic, no environment or perspective. Asset is an imaginative irregular shaped object, NOT a rectangular player panel. Landscape composition, one 1536x1024 PNG. A large circular midnight-blue instrument orb occupies the center-left, with a milled titanium and pearl-silver C-shaped orbital ring sweeping around it. The ring has real open gaps showing transparent background, small connected satellite capsules on the far right and underneath, with curved slender metal bridges. A bright restrained turquoise glow, dark navy enamel central disc, fine analog concentric machining, small polished screws. Layout: broad quiet solid navy circular center for live metadata; circular inset at upper-left of that hub for album artwork; wide smooth central/lower areas for text and time; three generous round control pads along the bottom arc; on the right, a small round satellite lobe and short horizontal capsule for volume; a low curved shelf across lower quarter for utility controls/status. Make the silhouette unmistakably circular and orbital with generous negative space in the upper-right and between satellite lobes. No large rectangular outer frame. Keep all object surfaces opaque, appearance can look like enamel/glass. Do not draw text, words, numbers, brand marks, playback glyphs, menus, sliders, UI widgets, or fake screen content. Leave quiet areas unmarked for host-rendered controls. Refined premium period industrial concept artwork, crisp natural details and excellent small-scale readability. Original design only, no copied Audion assets.
